disposition.file_count_and_pin_notes: existing _names MAX_FILES and lowercase _pin guards verified; not reproduced defects
residual_limits: output folder may remain if separate archive write fails; existing data never overwritten
bounded in-memory packaging; no concurrent hostile filesystem guarantee
client disconnect diagnostics are cosmetic; no public service deployment
